appended_items.title: Curatorial Search Query Challenge
appended_items.novel_reason: the submitted object is a constrained retrieval query rather than the retrieved answer
appended_items.design_trick: Score query design directly against retrieval behavior, turning search strategy into the benchmark output.

appended_items.title: Evidence-Guided Sustainability Claim Retrieval and Ledger Reconstruction
appended_items.novel_reason: damaged sustainability claims require both retrieval and ledger repair across values, dates, units, and scope
appended_items.design_trick: Use realistic report-like fields and require evidence-backed reconstruction of a structured claim ledger.

appended_items.title: Flightline View-Graph Budgeting
appended_items.novel_reason: photogrammetry edge-budget selection is a graph-optimization output grounded in real UAV views
appended_items.design_trick: Ask solvers to choose a minimal connected camera graph under visual matching constraints.

appended_items.title: Scientific Answer Evaluation Under Evidence Changes
appended_items.novel_reason: LLM evaluation is tested under changing evidence rather than static answer judging
appended_items.design_trick: Score whether an evaluator updates its judgment when evidence is withdrawn, contradicted, or narrowed.

appended_items.title: Chromosome Contact Fragment Scaffolding
appended_items.novel_reason: contact-map quilt scaffolding combines ordered assembly, decoy exclusion, and join-evidence matrices
appended_items.design_trick: Recover an oriented scaffold and evidence matrix from noisy contact fragments with overlapping decoys.

appended_items.title: Contaminated Manuscript Identification
appended_items.novel_reason: computational philology contamination detection is an uncommon structured NLP setting
appended_items.design_trick: Use variant readings across manuscripts to detect contamination rather than classify ordinary document topics.

appended_items.title: Few-Shot Recovery of Hidden Revision Decision Rules
appended_items.novel_reason: few-shot latent rule induction over revision alternatives creates a compact prompt-engineering benchmark pattern
appended_items.design_trick: Infer an unstated rule from demonstrations and apply it to new competing revisions.
